ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:
SECTION 1. Title 17 ofthe Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby
amended by changing all of the RMS Residential Multi-Unit District symbols and indications as
shown on Map No. 10-D in the area bounded by

a line 371.68 feet north of and parallel to East 47" Street; South Ellis Avenue; a

line 203.73 feet north of and parallel to East 47" Street; a line 174.96 feet west of

and parallel to South Ellis Avenue; a line 239.05 feet north of and parallel to East

47" Street; a line 288.31 feet west of and parallel to South Ellis Avenue,
to those of a RMS.5 Residential Multi-Unit District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance takes effect after its passage and due publication.

Common Street Address: 4624 S. Ellis Avenue.
